newsitem.title: FINLAND: AAMULEHTI CO BUYS HAAPAVESI PAPER.
newsitem.headline: AAMULEHTI CO BUYS HAAPAVESI PAPER.

text.p: Finnish media group Aamulehti Oy said in a statement on Tuesday its Suomen Paikallissanomat Oy had acquired the publication rights for the Jokivarsi regional paper in Haapavesi from Pohjois-Suomen Paikallisuutiset Oy.
The weekly paper's circulation is 2,400 copies -- less than half of the households in Haapavesi -- and it employs three people, Aamulehti said. It did not state the value of the deal.
Aamulehti said its Suomen Paikallissanomat publishes a competing paper called Pyhajokiseutu in the same region and that it aimed to merge the editorial operations of the two.
The seller is part of the Suomenmaa group, it said.
